High floor, but no pool listed

These fit everything except the pool requirement. Worth a look if a rooftop deck would do.

  • 2 E Erie #3005 · 30th fl · $950,000Newly remodeled 3/3 combined corner with skyline views and a balcony. Rooftop sundeck, no pool.
  • 737 W Washington #3607 · 36th fl · $997,747Skybridge, West Loop. Renovated 3/3 with two balconies and skyline/lake views. Sundeck, no pool. The only West Loop listing that was 12+ floors up.
  • 110 W Superior #2603 · 26th fl · $949,7473-bed half-floor unit with a 17×20 private deck. Sun deck, no pool.
  • 600 N Lake Shore Dr #2011 / #2411 · 20th, 24th fl · $1.38M / $1.449M3-bed units with lake views; two rooftop terraces and a garden terrace. No pool in either listing.
  • 800 N Michigan #4703 · 47th fl · $1,215,000Park Tower. Renovated 2-bed with Park Hyatt services. No pool mentioned.
  • Also no pool118 E Erie #28F (Ritz-Carlton Residences, $1.25M), 250 E Pearson #1903 ($1.2M), 1418 N Lake Shore #28 ($1.4M full floor), 1120 N Lake Shore #16B (co-op, $1.075M), 221 E Walton #13C ($1.25M duplex).
  • Cut for condition950 N Michigan #4005 ($825K, 40th fl, pool building) has mostly original finishes.

Where the search looked. A map box from the West Loop (west to about Ashland) to the lake, and from Congress north to Armitage. The Loop, South Loop and Lakeshore East were dropped as outside your list; Lakeshore East had about 15 12th-floor-plus listings in range (for example 225 N Columbus and 211 N Harbor) and is worth adding if you're open to it. Old Town had nothing on the 12th floor or higher in this price range.

How floors and pools were read. Floors come from the unit number (2701 means the 27th floor). Pools and outdoor space come from each listing's description, since Zillow didn't fill in structured amenity fields for these. Confirm both with the agent before touring.

Prices, HOA dues and days on market are as listed on Zillow on October 25, 2026.
